finamp.description:
Finamp is a free, open-source music player that lets you stream and enjoy your personal music collection from a Jellyfin server on Android.

Browse albums, artists, tracks, genres, and playlists through a modern, customizable interface. Stream directly from your server or download your music for offline listening, with support for gapless playback, transcoding, and volume normalization.

Enjoy synchronized lyrics, dynamic colors, light and dark themes, customizable home screens, and a powerful playback queue. Advanced listening features include sleep timers, playback speed controls, radio mode, instant mixes, and playlist editing.

Finamp also supports Jellyfin Quick Connect, playback history, playback reporting, and secure connections using custom certificates or mutual TLS. Android Auto integration is available on supported installations.

Finamp is developed openly under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 and is also available on iOS and desktop platforms.

An accessible Jellyfin server containing your own music is required. Finamp does not include music or connect to commercial streaming services. Android Auto may require installation through Google Play.
